AutoBurst.Description: Enables Trick Attack and Mug upgrades. Continue pressing ST/AoE; scripted openers stay off. Hide stays for prepull mudra reset; Kassatsu stays for prepull use.

AutoMitigation.Description: Enables Feint through ST. Wrath applies its readiness, content, HP and damage-detection conditions. Keep manual defenses for deliberate timing and paths not covered by automation. Automated and manual uses share cooldowns.

AutoMechanics.Description: Enables Kassatsu, Ten Chi Jin and Meisui during combat through ST/AoE. Hide stays for prepull mudra reset; Kassatsu stays for prepull use.
